claim_one_line: THE THREE-ENDED COVERS, SEALED. Every state whose companion's ends are divisible by 3 has a three-ended cover (13 to twelve ends); on them 46 member orbits, each a free Z/3 orbit trivial on no end with a one-dimensional interior, six of sign characters (inducing Z/2 x A4 triplets) and forty of order 4 (Delta(48)); n(1) = 0 on each, so every member carries at most one generation. Sealed question: is +LLLR's cover the only one whose generation-shaped members number exactly three?
